_meta: Labeled single-case battery for offline engine calibration.
expected tool = human expert's pick. NONE = no tool applies.
Runs against the SAME candidate set the live box scores (bridge menu).
Web-search cases are deliberately absent — internet-gated tools are not in the offline menu.
Every case should be solvable given the 12-tool menu + DELEGATE + NONE.
